integrity: A complete mathematical argument and reproducible independent matrix-enumeration checks are included; finite checks do not prove arbitrary parameters. Originality is limited to inspected sources.
scientific_limitations: Only repeated equal-length, unweighted permutation-cycle evolution algebras over finite fields; individual labelled algebra endomorphisms and composition-idempotent ranks, not conjugacy classes, arbitrary weights or mixed cycle lengths. Comparisons cannot exclude every unindexed equivalence.
title: Endomorphism monoids and retraction rank spectra of repeated cyclic evolution algebras
